SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Location, Position and Size of Kenya.
   D. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage as rumours only.
   B. Explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.
   D. Say Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage never happens in Kenya.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

5. Which statement about Population distribution in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Kenya.
   B. Explain Population distribution in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Population distribution in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Population distribution in Kenya as rumours only.

6. Which statement about The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui as rumours only.
   B. Say The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.

7. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Development of Transport never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Development of Transport.
   C. Treat Development of Transport as rumours only.
   D. Explain Development of Transport with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi.
   C. Treat Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi as rumours only.
   D. Say Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi never happens in Kenya.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. Which statement about School administration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat School administration as rumours only.
   B. Explain School administration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say School administration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing School administration.

11. Which statement about African Traditional Education is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing African Traditional Education.
   B. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say African Traditional Education never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites.
   D. Treat Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Population distribution in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain African Traditional Education and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain School administration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Mining in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
